name: Sierra Club Foundation
mission: The Sierra Club Foundation promotes climate solutions, conservation, and movement building through a powerful combination of strategic philanthropy and grassroots advocacy. We partner with individual and institutional donors to align financial resources with strategic outcomes, provide flexible funding for innovation, build capacity in the environmental movement, and create partnerships with a broad spectrum of allied organizations around shared values and goals. As the fiscal sponsor of the charitable programs of the Sierra Club, we provide resources to it and other nonprofit organizations to support scientific, educational, literary, organizing, advocacy, and legal programs that further our goals.

rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1960, the Sierra Club Foundation supports movement building, climate solutions, and public lands protection. The organization manages financial resources to grant capacity-building funds to major environmental initiatives across the United States. In FY2025, the foundation reported <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $31,947,339</cite>, while filing data shows total grantmaking and campaign investments spanning major efforts such as Beyond Coal and Our Wild America. The foundation maintains <cite id="1">a 97/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting strong overall transparency and accountability metrics. Public reporting shows that <cite id="1">86.0% of expenses go directly to program activities</cite>, while fundraising remains lean, costing <cite id="1">$0.08 per $1 raised</cite>. Operational costs are balanced alongside significant grant distributions, including <cite id="2">$228,877,399 in domestic grants</cite> paid out over recent tax cycles. The foundation carries <cite id="1">17.7 months of working capital</cite>, providing stability but indicating a high reserve balance relative to annual operational costs. Donors seeking to fund large-scale US environmental movement building can support these campaigns through general charitable giving and sadaqah.
